# Certificate View

## Summary
Printable 4:3 certificate face from plain values (so it previews before issue); seal, signatory, number, verify link, REVOKED stamp; print stylesheet.

## Usage
`<CertificateView @number @learnerName @courseTitle … />` — Certificate.isolated mounts it.

## Non-goals
No PDF generation.
attributes.cardDescription: A printable certificate face from plain values: seal, signatory, number, verification link and a revoked stamp.
